# WASM JavaScript API

Everything the [WASM](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/wasm) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go).

## $wasm

The app's modules, the pb_hooks/<name>.pb.wasm files. A module is a closed box: it gets its input and gives its output,
and reaches no database, file, network, environment or process.

Calls are async only: a module runs off the app's JS VM while the hook awaits it, so the app serves other requests
meanwhile. `$wasm.run(...)` without `.async` throws.

The output is the module's stdout: JSON parsed, a string when it isn't JSON, null when it's empty.

### $wasm.run

### $wasm.run.async()

```ts
$wasm.run.async(name: string, input?: WasmInput): Promise<T>
```

Calls the module's "run". Rejects with a `WasmError` when the call fails.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `input` | `WasmInput` (optional) |  |

Returns `Promise<T>`.

```js
onRecordCreate(async (e) => {
  const out = await $wasm.run.async("summary", { title: e.record.get("title"), body: e.record.get("body") })
  e.record.set("summary", out.text)
  return e.next()
}, "posts")
```

### $wasm.call

### $wasm.call.async()

```ts
$wasm.call.async(name: string, fn: string, input?: WasmInput): Promise<T>
```

Calls one of the module's functions (its first argument). Rejects with a `WasmError` when the call fails.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `fn` | `string` |  |
| `input` | `WasmInput` (optional) |  |

Returns `Promise<T>`.

```js
const r = await $wasm.call.async("crypto", "decrypt", { key, data })
```

### $wasm.inspect

### $wasm.inspect.async()

```ts
$wasm.inspect.async(name: string, fn: string, input?: WasmInput): Promise<WasmInspection<T>>
```

Calls a function to try a module out: never rejects for the call, and gives its log and timings.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `fn` | `string` |  |
| `input` | `WasmInput` (optional) |  |

Returns `Promise<WasmInspection<T>>`.

### $wasm.modules()

```ts
$wasm.modules(): Array<WasmModuleInfo>
```

Every module in pb_hooks/ and how it's doing.

Returns `Array<WasmModuleInfo>`.

### $wasm.limits()

```ts
$wasm.limits(): WasmLimits
```

What every call runs within: memory, time, how many calls and how many MB of modules at once.

Returns `WasmLimits`.

## Types

### WasmInput

What a module gets on stdin: a string or bytes (a typed array or an ArrayBuffer) as they are, nothing for undefined or null, anything else as JSON.

```ts
type WasmInput = string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | Array<number> | object | number | boolean | null | undefined
```

### WasmExample

One call to try a module with, from its manifest (what it prints for `<name> --describe`).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `function` | `string` | "run" when the manifest leaves it out. |
| `input` | `any` | A string is the module's stdin as it is (EDIFACT, XML, CSV); anything else is sent as JSON. |
| `output?` | `any` | What it gives, when the example says. |

### WasmModuleInfo

How one module in pb_hooks/ is doing, with what it says for --describe.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `running` | `boolean` | Its module checks out: it can be called. |
| `description?` | `string` |  |
| `version?` | `string` | The author's version, as the manifest writes it. |
| `functions?` | `Array<string>` | The functions it says it has; ["run"] by default. |
| `language?` | `string` | What it's written in: what the module says, else what its manifest says. |
| `repository?` | `string` | Where its source is: an http(s) URL. |
| `examples?` | `Array<WasmExample>` |  |
| `size?` | `number` | Its module's size in bytes: what a call of it takes of the app's `maxModulesMB` while it runs. |
| `error?` | `string` | Why it can't run (running false), or what's wrong with what it printed for --describe. |

### WasmLimits

What every module call in the app runs within.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `maxCallMemoryMB` | `number` | Memory each call may allocate (heap, stack, input). Every call has its own, not shared. |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | Time limit for a call's run (compiling comes before it). |
| `maxConcurrent` | `number` | Calls running at once. |
| `maxModulesMB` | `number` | MB of modules running at once: the sizes of the calls' modules, added up. With 10, two calls of a Go module (~4.4 MB) run at once, and `maxConcurrent` of a Rust or Zig one (~0.1 MB). Also the largest module that loads. |
| `maxPayload` | `number` | Largest input or output of a call, in bytes. |

### WasmErrorCode

The codes ext/wasm gives; a module can give its own (it exits non-zero with {"code", "message"} on stderr).

### WasmError

What a failed $wasm.run.async or $wasm.call.async rejects with: catch it to decide what the hook does next.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `"WasmError"` |  |
| `module` | `string` | The module's name. |
| `code` | `WasmErrorCode` |  |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Whether the same call may work later (busy, timeout...). |

### WasmInspection

What $wasm.inspect.async gives: one call, with its log and its timings.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `output` | `T \| null` | The output; null when the call failed or the module wrote nothing. |
| `stderr` | `string` | What the module wrote to stderr: its log. |
| `error` | `{ code: WasmErrorCode; message: string; retryable: boolean } \| null` | Why the call failed, or null. |
| `compileMs` | `number` |  |
| `runMs` | `number` |  |
